listing.name: Wild 9 (Wild9Recomp)
listing.summary: A Wild 9 portable player for your own NTSC-U/USA SLUS-00425 PlayStation CUE and all referenced BIN tracks, including boot executable SLUS_004.25 and the remaining disc files. OpenBIOS is included; your own Sony SCPH BIOS is optional. Official Windows x86-64 ZIP, Linux x86-64 ZIP/AppImage and macOS x86-64/ARM64 ZIP packages need no compiler, Python or MSVC; Linux needs glibc 2.28+. Recent packages include checksum sidecars. Follow the project’s original-file setup; Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.
